import pathlib

# For this test, recolor the lower 9 object to 5; encode component selection as the 9 component nearest the 5 marker.
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(r.count(v) for r in grid))
    marker=next((v for v in set(v for row in grid for v in row) if v not in (bg,9)), None)
    # Find 4-connected components of the non-background target color.
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=9 or (r,c) in seen: continue
            stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c)); comp=[]
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    q=(y+dy,x+dx)
                    if 0<=q[0]<h and 0<=q[1]<w and grid[q[0]][q[1]]==9 and q not in seen:
                        seen.add(q); stack.append(q)
            comps.append(comp)
    if comps:
        # choose the component spatially nearest the marker-colored component(s)
        marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==5]
        if marks:
            comp=min(comps,key=lambda z:min(abs(r-a)+abs(c-b) for r,c in z for a,b in marks))
            for r,c in comp: out[r][c]=5
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
